name: openai-balance
description: Your OpenAI API credit above the prompt: an estimated balance with a gauge, today's spend, and the model and key of the last call. /openai-balance shows the breakdown.

adminKey.title: OpenAI Admin key
adminKey.description: An organization Admin key (sk-admin-..., read-only is enough) from platform.openai.com → Settings → Organization → Admin keys. Empty uses OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY, then the macOS Keychain item openai-admin-key.
